# Extract "End of period" balance data for July-January of each fiscal year

# 1962-1963 (from treasury_bulletin_1963_02_page_45.txt)

    'July 1962': 5528,
    'August 1962': 4637,
    'September 1962': 4770,
    'October 1962': 7342,
    'November 1962': 3841,
    'December 1962': 5374,
    'January 1963': 4206
}

# 1963-1964 (from treasury_bulletin_1964_02_page_38.txt)
fy_1963_64 = {
    'July 1963': 6730,
    'August 1963': 5350,
    'September 1963': 5765,
    'October 1963': 6813,
    'November 1963': 4022,
    'December 1963': 4792,
    'January 1964': 4995
}

# 1964-1965 (from treasury_bulletin_1965_02_page_42.txt)
fy_1964_65 = {
    'July 1964': 6519,
    'August 1964': 4514,
    'September 1964': 4880,
    'October 1964': 6434,
    'November 1964': 3394,
    'December 1964': 6699,
    'January 1965': 4198
}

def compute_metrics(data_dict, label):
    values = list(data_dict.values())
    range_val = max(values) - min(values)
    avg_val = sum(values) / len(values)
    percentage = (range_val / avg_val) * 100
    print(f"\n{label}:")
    print(f"  Values: {values}")
    print(f"  Max: {max(values)}, Min: {min(values)}")
    print(f"  Range: {range_val}")
    print(f"  Average: {avg_val:.2f}")
    print(f"  Range as % of Average: {percentage:.2f}%")
    return range_val, avg_val, percentage

r2, a2, p2 = compute_metrics(fy_1963_64, "1963-1964")
r3, a3, p3 = compute_metrics(fy_1964_65, "1964-1965")

print("\n" + "="*50)
print("Summary of percentages:")
print(f"  1962-1963: {p1:.2f}%")
print(f"  1963-1964: {p2:.2f}%")
print(f"  1964-1965: {p3:.2f}%")

highest = max(p1, p2, p3)
print(f"\nHighest percentage: {highest:.2f}%")

# Round to nearest hundredths
print(f"\nFinal answer (rounded to nearest hundredths): {round(highest, 2)}")
